description: This Java class implements a notification scheduling service for Thingsboard, managing scheduled notification requests, handling partition events, and executing notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: DefaultNotificationSchedulerService
classes.description: A service class that schedules and manages notification requests, handles partition events, and executes notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: ScheduledRequestMetadata
classes.description: A helper class holding tenant ID and scheduled future for a notification request.

methods.name: onAddedPartitions
methods.description: Handles newly added partitions by scheduling existing notification requests.

methods.name: scheduleNotificationRequest
methods.description: Schedules a notification request based on tenant ID, request ID, and timestamp.

methods.name: scheduleNotificationRequest
methods.description: Schedules a notification request with detailed request object and timestamp.

methods.name: handleComponentLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Handles component lifecycle events, such as deletion of notification requests or tenants, to cancel scheduled notifications.

methods.name: cleanupEntityOnPartitionRemoval
methods.description: Cleans up scheduled notification requests when a partition is removed.

methods.name: cancelAndRemove
methods.description: Cancels and removes a scheduled notification request.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: getSchedulerExecutorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the scheduler executor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler and stops the service.
